title: Choose a board-free Poorup homepage
question: The board stays inside the game. Choose the homepage composition that should introduce the parlor.

options.label: Parlor Desk
options.lineage: typographic entry desk with one focused action panel
options.thesis: Put the Poorup statement on the left and a single Create / Join desk on the right, with identity kept close but subordinate.
options.viewport: A full-width two-zone stage uses desktop space without a board-shaped placeholder or an empty center.
options.risk: Type scale and texture must provide the signature that the removed board used to provide.

options.label: Terminal Switchboard
options.lineage: numbered home routes with a live directory column
options.thesis: Make Play, Rooms, Profile, and Rules real terminal routes beside one active command panel and truthful room discovery.
options.viewport: A three-column control surface keeps navigation, action, and live directory visible at once.
options.risk: The active panel needs a strong focal hierarchy so the menu does not overpower the entry action.

options.label: Ticket Booth
options.lineage: centered marquee with two ruled entry tickets
options.thesis: Use a large after-hours marquee above two clear Create and Join tickets, then keep identity and status in one compact strip.
options.viewport: The entry pair stays centered and immediately visible while the skyline becomes a quiet horizon layer.
options.risk: The ticket metaphor must remain native, readable, and action-first rather than decorative.

canonCard.label: Current composition
canonCard.thesis: Keep the board-shaped homepage and adjust spacing only.
canonCard.viewport: The current homepage remains the fallback if a board-free direction does not fit.
canonCard.risk: The board competes with the entry task and the desktop layout remains uneven.
